title: Underwhelming at best...too bad.
text: The DP on the unicorn is cool, but the rest of the box is clearly underwhelming.  Even the packaging.  Was a subscriber the whole time when Funko ran the program themselves and this is a sad start to it under Amazon’s watch.  I get that boxes might have a variety of items in them, but starting with the minimum number for the first box is kind of a lousy beginning.  The Hulkbuster, and other filler items, that launched the original box line clearly had more time and engery invested in them.
label: negative
